notes.title: Sippy May Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added tutorial on the main menu
[*]Added ability to zoom and slowed screen panning for more accurate clicking
[*]Improved sounds to be more gentle
[/list]

Thank you all for the support and feedback! Be on the lookout for exciting updates next month!

notes.title: Sippy's Spring Fling Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/db72e2e57a330f9a78e7fe1ac41d59a5fce1502a.png[/img]
Sippy is already off on a new adventure to explore the season of spring! Just download the update and select Spring Fling on the level selection page or, if you haven't already, purchase the whole game for a discounted price for a limited time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/c87b6d8948c816c770c6331c3147ebd67045036b.png[/img]
This update includes:
[list]
[*]30 new levels
[*]9 new skins
[*]2 new accessories
[*]A rabbit character
[*]An egg obstacle
[/list]

In addition, I fixed a bug where sippy would keep walking if you changed levels while moving.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/376e0548b34a93726dc214f67c78235e7e6ecf85.png[/img]

tags.bug: In addition, I fixed a bug where sippy would keep walking if you changed levels while moving.

notes.title: Patch 1 - Quality of Life
notes.content:
I heard your feedback and am listening!
This patch has a lot of quality of life features including:
[list]
[*]Menu button in game is now on the right close to where the menu opens
[*]Added a reset level button
[*]Added a level select button in the pause menu
[*]The game now checks for a perfect score after every level completion
[/list]
Be on the lookout for more exciting features coming up soon!

tags.feature: -Menu button in game is now on the right close to where the menu opens
-Added a level select button in the pause menu
-The game now checks for a perfect score after every level completion

notes.title: March 4th Update
notes.content:
What an exciting launch! This is a quick build with some urgent bugfixes.
I am listening to the feedback and will add some quality of life features soon including a level restart button and a level select option in the menu.
Thank you everyone for the support!

tags.bug: - This is a quick build with some urgent bugfixes.

notes.title: Get Ready to Groove!
notes.content:
It's been an adventure getting ready to launch my first game on Steam! I'm excited to launch Sippy this Friday! 

[b]Some exciting updates before release:[/b]
[list]
[*]Character customization options
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/54d12282b47dfe68c6e4035c9f761e3b03f14ab9.gif[/img]
[*]Voice acting for Sippy
[*]A new song for the credits screen
[/list]

Stay tuned for the release this Friday March 1st!

tags.feature: - A new song for the credits screen
